confirmed_findings.title: Missing statistics publish measured zeros
confirmed_findings.mechanism: Five defaults feed four metrics before missing-value formatting. Undefined nonloading or partial stats become zeros/0/0 despite no measured payload.
confirmed_findings.repro_not_executed: Synthetic stats=undefined,isLoading=false,error=undefined; or only sent=9. Inspect formatter inputs; no API request.
confirmed_findings.recommended_fix: Pass unknown values/reasons through the existing numeric metric API; preserve all four metrics and explicit unbounded period.

confirmed_findings.title: Provider counts erase upstream channel trust

evidence.exact_source_line: // Derive per-kind counts + the number of provider types in use once per

confirmed_findings.mechanism: Absent/fatal/loading/paused channels become [] with no trust prop. Catalog claims zero in use/Not configured before an authoritative result. Retained counts also lack their own derived trust notice.
confirmed_findings.repro_not_executed: Synthetic channels query data=undefined with loading/fatal/paused; compare provider input with successful empty result.
confirmed_findings.recommended_fix: Keep full provider catalog visible; pass source state and distinguish unknown/loading/fatal/retained counts.

confirmed_findings.title: Initial paused channels appear authoritatively empty
confirmed_findings.mechanism: Initial paused TanStack state has isPending=true,isLoading=false,fetchStatus=paused and no data. Only isLoading/fatalError is consumed, so grid receives []/false/false and takes empty branch.
confirmed_findings.repro_not_executed: Synthetic query data=undefined,isPending=true,isLoading=false,isError=false,fetchStatus=paused; source-trace grid props only.
confirmed_findings.recommended_fix: Consume initial/blocked state explicitly; preserve neighbor sections and do not invent a server/offline error.

confirmed_findings.title: Paused key lookup is mislabeled unsupported browser

evidence.exact_source_line: return t('webpush.unsupported.pushApi', "This browser doesn't support the Push API.");

confirmed_findings.mechanism: On a capable browser with unresolved paused key, publicKey is undefined and isPushSupported=false until key exists; isLoading=false bypasses checking and yields unsupported Push API.
confirmed_findings.repro_not_executed: Synthetic Notification/PushManager/serviceWorker-capable state; key data undefined, isPending=true,isLoading=false,fetchStatus=paused; no lookup executed.
confirmed_findings.recommended_fix: Extend existing readiness owner to distinguish unresolved/blocked key from known disabled server and absent browser capability.

confirmed_findings.title: Local lookup unknown/failure becomes Not subscribed
confirmed_findings.mechanism: isSubscribed starts false; rejected registration/subscription lookup is swallowed without checking/error/retry output. With loaded key, card claims absence before local truth is established.
confirmed_findings.repro_not_executed: Use only synthetic deferred/rejected getSubscription/getRegistration; inspect output/card branch.
confirmed_findings.recommended_fix: Expose/consume explicit checking, known absent/subscribed, lookup failure and retry in the existing hook/card.

confirmed_findings.title: Unsubscribe reports completion despite failures
confirmed_findings.mechanism: Server DELETE and browser unsubscribe rejections are swallowed; resolved false from browser unsubscribe also ignored. Local state is cleared and true returned, suppressing the card action failure signal.
confirmed_findings.repro_not_executed: Existing synthetic hook setup: reject server/browser operations or resolve browser unsubscribe=false; inspect final return/state. Never unsubscribe a real device.
confirmed_findings.recommended_fix: Keep server-first/best effort but return truthful partial/failure and reconcile actual state.

confirmed_findings.title: Registered devices shell disappears for empty/unresolved rows
confirmed_findings.mechanism: Heading/list shell are inside positive-length gate. Successful [] has no affirmative empty explanation. Initial paused list has neither heading nor skeleton.
confirmed_findings.repro_not_executed: Synthetic successful [] and initial-paused undefined subscriptions; inspect heading/list branch.
confirmed_findings.recommended_fix: Always retain section shell with known-empty explanation, explicit blocked/loading/fatal and retained states.

confirmed_findings.title: Credential-bearing webhook URL is not masked

evidence.exact_source_line: content: 'Full HTTPS endpoint that receives JSON-formatted alert payloads. Treat as a credential — anyone with this URL can post to your channel.',

confirmed_findings.mechanism: Metadata calls Discord/Slack webhook_url a credential, but mask helper checks only token/key/password. Flattening exposes webhook_url and card renders it verbatim. Truncation does not remove DOM value.
confirmed_findings.repro_not_executed: Use only existing synthetic Discord/Slack URL or .invalid credential-shaped string; trace isSecretField(webhook_url)=false. No real URL read/configured.
confirmed_findings.recommended_fix: Use explicit credential classification at existing metadata helper; preserve editing while masking credential-bearing previews.

confirmed_findings.title: Channel toggle remains enabled while inversion is pending
confirmed_findings.mechanism: toggleMut.isPending never reaches Toggle.disabled; handler has no pending latch. Shared Toggle defaults enabled, allowing another inversion dispatch before refetched state.
confirmed_findings.repro_not_executed: Set existing synthetic toggle double isPending=true; inspect props or future mocked repeated activations.
confirmed_findings.recommended_fix: Disable/latch only this mutation switch; preserve independent other channel actions.

confirmed_findings.title: Generic test hook emits success for success=false
confirmed_findings.mechanism: Hook-level transport onSuccess ignores response.success. Card/modal correctly branch on provider false, creating contradictory success feedback on a fulfilled failure response.
confirmed_findings.repro_not_executed: Use a mocked request fulfilled with {success:false,error:synthetic failure}; source-trace real hook and caller callbacks, never send a message.
confirmed_findings.recommended_fix: Make actual hook result-aware and establish a single feedback owner.

confirmed_findings.title: Generic actions have hook and caller toast owners
confirmed_findings.mechanism: Card delete/toggle/test and generic modal test toast in caller while generic hooks also toast success/error. Webhook test hook intentionally has no toast and is a distinct acceptable path.
confirmed_findings.repro_not_executed: Inspect real hook callbacks plus mocked request/caller callbacks; source proves duplicate owners, not an observed live toast.
confirmed_findings.recommended_fix: Consolidate at P264 while retaining channel-specific names/reasons and inline results.

confirmed_findings.title: Save does not invalidate enabled/total statistics
confirmed_findings.mechanism: Save success invalidates channels only; delete/toggle invalidate both channels and stats. Creating/editing enabled state leaves stats prior payload until periodic polling.
confirmed_findings.repro_not_executed: Inspect save onSuccess after synthetic fulfilled create/edit; compare invalidation calls with delete/toggle. No real mutation.
confirmed_findings.recommended_fix: Invalidate/broadcast existing stats key after save, preserving keys and polling.

confirmed_findings.title: Provider ARIA radios lack native arrow navigation
confirmed_findings.mechanism: Seven native Buttons labeled ARIA radios have no native same-name radio inputs, roving tabIndex or arrow-key handler. ARIA roles alone add no keyboard behavior; each Button remains a separate Tab stop.
confirmed_findings.repro_not_executed: Inspect generated create picker props; future synthetic keyboard check must exercise ArrowRight/selection/focus, not just click/aria-checked.
confirmed_findings.recommended_fix: Reuse existing RadioCard/native radio group; preserve seven provider options and configuration reset.
